sections.title: The Role of the Clinical Research Nurse: Principles, Procedures, and Purpose
sections.description: This course will focus on providing the framework for Clinical Research Nurses (CRN) to successfully use the International Association of Clinical Research Nurses Scope and Standards for Clinical Research Nursing and Core Competencies in their practice. Upon completion of the course, students will be able to identify the intersection of foundational clinical nursing skills and the clinical research nursing domains of practice. They will be able to identify strategies to engage with various internal and external stakeholders.
